task:
Make `pnpm shared:lint` work on Windows (2026-10-31 audit leftover).

apps/web/package.json has "shared:lint": "cd ../.. && apps/web/node_modules/.bin/eslint --config apps/web/eslint.shared.config.js packages/api-client/src packages/planner-core/src". On Windows (cmd/PowerShell via pnpm) the POSIX-style path to the .bin shim fails, so the owner cannot run it on their Windows desktop or laptop. Replace it with a cross-platform form that keeps exactly the same lint scope and config. Options: run eslint through `pnpm exec`/the package binary name from a small Node launcher script under apps/web/scripts/ that sets cwd to the repository root and calls ESLint's Node API (new ESLint({ overrideConfigFile, cwd })), or another approach that works with ESLint flat config's base-path rules (files outside the config's base directory are otherwise ignored, which is why the script cd's to the root today). Do not add new dependencies. Keep CI's existing invocation working (search .github/workflows for shared:lint and any contract tests under tests/ that pin the script text, and update them to the new contract). Prove it: the command lints the same file set as before (print the file count in the launcher's output) and fails on an injected lint error in packages/planner-core/src (test via a temporary fixture in a unit test, not a committed error). CHANGES.md entry.
